title: Subtype list
description: The type-line subtype vocabulary under data/oracle/card/component/type_line/. Each subtype entry names the card types it can accompany under CR 205.3c. The words each language shows for the subtypes live under data/print/<lang>/card/component/type_line/.

id.description: The stable subtype ID referenced by a type line.

card_types.description: Card-type IDs with which this subtype is valid.
